check("唯一匹配本批账号",b.total===1&&Array.isArray(b.rows)&&b.rows.length===1&&b.rows[0].userName===pm.environment.get("t44Name"));const u=b.rows[0];check("ID为有效正整数",Number.isSafeInteger(u.userId)&&u.userId>1);pm.variables.set("t44UserId",u.userId);

item.name: 08 回查用户部门角色状态

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t44Stage"))!==7)throw Error("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

const u=b.data;check("用户ID及账号正确",u&&u.userId===Number(pm.variables.get("t44UserId"))&&u.userName===pm.environment.get("t44Name"));check("部门和状态正确",u.deptId===202&&u.status==="0");check("角色仅101且无岗位",JSON.stringify(b.roleIds)==="[101]"&&Array.isArray(b.postIds)&&b.postIds.length===0);pm.variables.set("t44Page",1);pm.variables.set("t44ExpectedIds","[]");

request.description: T4.4本机正常链，按编号顺序运行。运行时凭据来自本地环境/本批响应；中断后先核对清理，不重复创建。

item.name: 09 管理员完整分页范围基准

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t44Stage"))!==8)throw Error("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

check("分页结构有效",Array.isArray(b.rows)&&Number.isInteger(b.total));const page=Number(pm.variables.get("t44Page"));let ids=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t44ExpectedIds"));ids.push(...b.rows.filter(u=>u.deptId===202).map(u=>u.userId));pm.variables.set("t44ExpectedIds",JSON.stringify(ids));if(page*10<b.total){check("未到末页时仍有记录",b.rows.length>0);pm.variables.set("t44Page",page+1);next(pm.info.requestId);}else{check("基准包含本轮新用户",ids.includes(Number(pm.variables.get("t44UserId"))));check("基准ID无重复",new Set(ids).size===ids.length);

request.description: T4.4本机正常链，按编号顺序运行。运行时凭据来自本地环境/本批响应；中断后先核对清理，不重复创建。

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t44Stage"))!==10)throw Error("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

check("身份为本批用户",b.user&&b.user.userId===Number(pm.variables.get("t44UserId"))&&b.user.userName===pm.environment.get("t44Name")&&!b.user.admin);check("部门为202",b.user.deptId===202);check("仅查询角色",JSON.stringify(b.roles)==='["t25_query_1009"]');check("查询权限且无新增权限",Array.isArray(b.permissions)&&JSON.stringify(b.permissions.slice().sort())==='["system:user:list","system:user:query"]');pm.variables.set("t44ActualIds","[]");pm.variables.set("t44Page",1);

request.description: T4.4本机正常链，按编号顺序运行。运行时凭据来自本地环境/本批响应；中断后先核对清理，不重复创建。

item.name: 12 新用户完整分页获准访问

exec: if(Number(pm.variables.get("t44Stage"))!==11)throw Error("前置步骤未通过，请从本批起点运行");

check("分页结构有效",Array.isArray(b.rows)&&Number.isInteger(b.total));check("本页记录均属于部门202",b.rows.every(u=>u.deptId===202));let ids=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t44ActualIds"));ids.push(...b.rows.map(u=>u.userId));pm.variables.set("t44ActualIds",JSON.stringify(ids));const page=Number(pm.variables.get("t44Page"));if(page*10<b.total){check("未到末页时仍有记录",b.rows.length>0);pm.variables.set("t44Page",page+1);next(pm.info.requestId);}else{const expected=JSON.parse(pm.variables.get("t44ExpectedIds")).sort((a,b)=>a-b);check("完整ID集合等于管理员本部门基准",JSON.stringify(ids.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b))===JSON.stringify(expected));check("总数及分页无重复",ids.length===b.total&&new Set(ids).size===ids.length);
